questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-17'}) WHERE tr.trStatus = 'Completed' RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.785'}) WHERE tr.conclusions IS NOT NULL RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.conclusions
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport) WHERE tr.trStatus = 'Draft' RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

questions.description: 특정 TR(38.803)이 영향 준 TS 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.803'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY s.specNumber
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.860'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact) RETURN imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.evidenceStatus, imp.verifiedImpactScope
questions.claim_contract: Stored claim inventory: return the declared impact type together with evidenceStatus; pending/rejected records are not established incorporation.

questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType: 'NewTS', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified', verifiedImpactScope: 'new_specification'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, s.specNumber ORDER BY tr.trNumber
questions.claim_contract: The proposed impactType is retained. This factual operation query requires the independently source-assessed verifiedImpactScope; published definition/analysis reuse alone does not establish creation or extension.

questions.description: 섹션을 확장한 TR 목록은? (ExtendSection, RAN4 impactType 실측)
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType: 'ExtendSection', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified', verifiedImpactScope: 'existing_section_change'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, s.specNumber ORDER BY tr.trNumber LIMIT 20
questions.note: 2026-04-22 CQ 감사 결과에 따른 정정: 원본 'NewSection' 쿼리는 RAN4 데이터에 존재하지 않음(RAN4 impactType 실측 ExtendSection=64, NewTS=4 / NewSection=0). RAN1 sed 복사 흔적으로 판단. RAN4 실제 데이터(ExtendSection)로 재설계.
questions.claim_contract: The proposed impactType is retained. This factual operation query requires the independently source-assessed verifiedImpactScope; published definition/analysis reuse alone does not establish creation or extension.

questions.description: 특정 TS(38.101-1)에 영향 준 TR 목록은? (역방향)
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.101-1'}) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, imp.impactType, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY tr.trNumber

questions.description: NR RF 연구 TR 38.803이 어떤 TS에 영향을 미쳤는가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.803'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY s.specNumber

questions.description: 7–24 GHz 주파수 범위 연구 TR 38.820이 TS에 미친 영향은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.820'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trStatus, s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.description: NTN RF 연구 TR 38.863이 TS에 미친 영향과 상세 내용은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.863'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY s.specNumber

questions.description: Rel-17을 타겟으로 하는 TR 연구 목록과 영향 유형은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-17'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, collect(DISTINCT imp.impactType) AS impactTypes, collect(DISTINCT imp.verifiedImpactScope) AS verifiedScopes ORDER BY tr.trNumber

questions.description: IAB RF 연구(TR 38.809)의 현재 진행 상태와 연구 범위는?
Extended 600 MHz NR band 연구 TR 38.860의 결론과 TS 반영 현황은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.860'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.conclusions, s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.description: 특정 TR(38.771)이 참조하는 다른 TR 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.771'})-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(ref:TechnicalReport) RETURN ref.trNumber, ref.trTitle ORDER BY ref.trNumber
questions.note: 조회 기준 TR은 outgoing REFERENCES_TR 이 가장 많은 TR 중 trNumber 가 가장 작은 것(38.771 → 38.810 · 38.871 · 38.884). 이전 조회 기준 TR 38.803 은 outgoing 이 0 이라 allow_zero 로 어떤 KG 에서도 통과했다.
questions.question: 38.771이 참조하는 다른 TR은? (outgoing REFERENCES_TR)

questions.description: 특정 TR(38.803)을 참조하는 다른 TR 목록은? (역참조)
questions.cypher: MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.803'}) RETURN ref.trNumber, ref.trTitle ORDER BY ref.trNumber
MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport) WITH tr, count(ref) AS refCount RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 5
